senses.sense_definition: Het toestand of verschijnsel waarbij de ademhaling ernstig wordt belemmerd, vaak met de dood of bewusteloosheid tot gevolg.

examples.text: Het slachtoffer overleed helaas aan de gevolgen van <w>verstikking</w> door de rook.

target_lang_translations.en: Unfortunately, the victim died from the effects of <w>suffocation</w> by smoke.

examples.text: De artsen wisten de patiënt net op tijd te redden van dood door <w>verstikking</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The doctors managed to save the patient just in time from death by <w>asphyxiation</w>.

target_lang_definitions.en: The condition or phenomenon in which breathing is severely obstructed, often resulting in death or unconsciousness.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: general term for being unable to breathe due to obstruction or lack of air
medical or formal term for extreme lack of oxygen leading to unconsciousness or death
inability to breathe caused by an obstruction in the throat
